then.text: Séamus. Everyone says Séamus, they just won't say it first. Now you need a céilí band for the crowning. A fiddler in Gaoth Dobhair and a box player in Donegal Town, if you can get them.

Who should be king? Ah. I've counted, unofficially, the way you count on an island: by who gets mentioned in the shop. It's Séamus. The man on the pier. He's met every boat for twenty years without being asked.
But a crowning needs music. Get a fiddler from Gaoth Dobhair and a box player from Donegal Town and we'll have a proper céilí.

else.text: {greeting} These are by islanders. The sea, the cliffs, the boats, the lighthouse. Painted on whatever they had: board, card, the back of a door once.
An English painter came out in the fifties, and the fishermen watched him and decided they'd have a go. They were better at the sea than he was. He said so himself.
